description:
The woman I love, the one I’ve cherished above all others, is being taken by another man right before my eyes! My heart should be breaking, and my blood should be boiling with righteous fury at the sight of her in someone else’s arms. But as I watch from the shadows, a chilling realization begins to sink in, freezing the air in my lungs. Something is horribly, inexplicably wrong with this picture. Why does it look like she’s enjoying this? In fact, she seems more than just willing... She looks more captivated and thrilled than she ever was with me! Welcome to a world where conventional romance is turned inside out. This is a curated collection of fantasy short stories designed specifically for readers with "unique" and provocative tastes. Explore the blurry lines between betrayal, obsession, and unexpected pleasure in these daring tales.

(Source: Lezhin US)
